the following issues: (1) the perceived success of activity and traditional costing systems, (2) the relationship between the usage of activity‐based costing (ABC) and traditional costing, (3) the impact of the usage of ABC and traditional costing on the perceived success of costing systems and (4) the impact of perceived success of costing system usage on organizational effectiveness.

the activity‐based system is more likely to provide a more comprehensive view of the cost structure of a company and to support the development and implementation of more effective management accounting and control systems.
